00 Meta
Mexico City, October 24, 2022
MR. WILLIAM W. POPP
Ambassador
Embassy of the United States in Guatemala City
Mr. Ambassador,
As we understand the new opportunities that creators, entrepreneurs, micro, small and medium-sized businesses have with the
evolution of the Internet, at Meta we want to promote the development of new skills so that they can take advantage of the
economic opportunities that digital commerce offers.
Today we double down on our efforts in Guatemala, so that more MSMEs and entrepreneurs from the creative sectors have
access to these skills and digital tools. We do this through our free training programs. In these programs, workshops and
resources are deployed where attendees learn to use digital marketing and Augmented Reality tools.
To showcase the commitment that Meta has with Guatemala, on November 9 we will hold a face-to-face event at the Zona Viva
Forum, where we hope to have over 150 MSMEs and members of the creative economy. The event will begin at 10:00 a.m.
On this occasion, we also want to announce the launch of our augmented reality training program, which will be Meta's first big
step towards the collaborative construction of the Metaverse in the country.
We would be honored to have you present at the event we are hosting with the hope to have more people join the next
generation of the Internet and develop fundamental skills for their early inclusion in the new digital economy.
We put at your disposal the email of our external advisors for the corresponding coordination: |
that of my colleague
[contact omitted].
[contact omitted] and
Thanking you in advance for your time and consideration,
Zügey
ÍÑIGO FERNÁNDEZ
Director of Public Policy for Mexico, Central America, and the Caribbean
